title: TID root physics — GW150914
question: Do bounded TID candidate features distinguish the GW150914 event window from fixed off-event controls under one reproducible measurement contract?
result_summary: A descriptive first pass with four pre-registered off-event controls is null-ish: event-window multifractal width is somewhat above control medians, while PSD slope, sample entropy, and raw detector coherence do not strongly separate the event.
does_not_establish: This does not establish calibrated statistical significance, a universal TID threshold, or new gravitational-wave physics.
next_gate: Expand to a larger off-event null distribution with symmetric whitening and detector time alignment before calibrated inference.
